justification: Both surfaces show schematic, simplified figures with clearly separated limbs carved into stone, and each may include a quadruped in profile, but that is about as generic as shared content gets. A is dominated by scattered stick-like anthropomorphs with raised arms, while B is an ordered, register-based composition of animals (birds, quadrupeds, a snake-like form) beneath a row of arch/head motifs and a chevron band, with no human figures at all.
